description: Locked design system shared across every static ad in every client. Loaded by Agent 9 before producing any AD-XXX.json. Footer-free for standard Meta ads. Brand-color slots are filled per-client from each client's Creative Bible.

canvas.rationale: 4:5 is Meta's recommended feed format and earns ~20% more vertical screen on mobile vs 1:1 square.

zone_1_brand_mark.spec: EMPTY clean white card 360x140px positioned top-left with 60px margin. NO logo, no text, no icons. Real client logo PNG composited in post via Canva (10 seconds per ad).

zone_2_hero_visual_and_headline.purpose: The pitch — hero photo + headline + accent shapes
zone_2_hero_visual_and_headline.spec: Concept-specific. AI generates the photo, the headline typography, eyebrows, attribution, subhead, fine print, and any decorative accents (diagonal slashes, halftone, dot patterns). Reference image (REF-XXX) drives layout DNA.

zone_3_trust_strip.purpose: Credibility row — 4 trust elements separated by accent hairlines
zone_3_trust_strip.spec: Single horizontal row of exactly 4 trust elements separated by 1px [PRIMARY ACCENT COLOR] vertical hairlines, on a semi-transparent dark panel rgba(0,0,0,0.65). Uppercase tracked-out white sans-serif 18-20pt, evenly spaced. Format: [BADGE 1] | [CREDENTIAL] | [DIFFERENTIATOR] | [PRE-QUALIFIER].

zone_4_cta_block_full_bleed.purpose: The action — CTA button extends to bottom edge
zone_4_cta_block_full_bleed.spec: Solid [CTA COLOR] rounded rectangle CTA button with bold white type. Centered horizontally. Generous breathing room above and below the button (8% canvas margin). Block extends full-bleed to the bottom edge of the canvas — NO reserved footer zone. Meta's platform CTA button + business name handle contact.

footer_policy.default: NONE — standard Meta cold-traffic and warm-traffic ads have no baked-in footer. Zone 4 extends to bottom edge.
footer_policy.exceptions: Flyer-mode / print-ready ads ONLY. For flyers, door hangers, mailers, partner placements: a separate branded footer asset (1440x125 transparent PNG) is composited in Canva. Built once per client during Agent 4's run and stored at /CLIENTS/[Client]/03_assets/branded_footer.png.
footer_policy.rationale: Meta already shows business name + CTA button below the ad. A baked-in phone/URL footer is partially redundant and eats vertical space.

primary_accent_color.use_case: Headline tags, hairline dividers, decorative accents, eyebrow lines
primary_accent_color.constraint: Must be a single high-contrast color. Yellows, reds, oranges, deep blues all viable depending on client brand.

cta_color.constraint: Must contrast with primary accent and with white type. Reds and deep blues are most reliable for CTAs.

structural_palette.constraint: Locked across every client. Do not vary.

headlines.specs: Heavy uppercase condensed sans-serif. Per-client choice from Creative Bible Format sheet.

subheads_and_taglines.default: italic serif OR italic clean sans for warmth
subheads_and_taglines.specs: 12-16pt italic. Slight italic slant for human-feel.

body_and_trust_strip.specs: Clean modern sans-serif. Trust strip uppercase tracked-out 18-20pt. Fine print 10-12pt light grey.

handwritten_taglines.specs: Italic handwritten script, 18-22pt. For founder-signature lines.

ai_generates: Zone 2: hero photo + headline + accent shapes + decorative elements
Zone 3: trust strip with all 4 elements rendered legibly
composite_in_canva: Zone 1: drop client logo PNG into top-left placeholder
Optional flyer-mode: drop branded footer overlay
ai_vs_canva_split.rationale: AI image gen is unreliable on small text and on logo recreation. Generate everything large in AI; composite identity-locked elements (logo, exact phone number) in Canva.

image_input_policy.founder_portraits: ALWAYS upload founder reference photo as image input alongside JSON. AI cannot lock likeness from text description alone.
image_input_policy.specific_install_photos: Upload as image input when concept calls for a SPECIFIC real install. Generic install scenes can be AI-generated.
image_input_policy.logo_recreation: NEVER attempt logo recreation in AI. Always composite real PNG in Canva.
image_input_policy.handling: Set 'image_input_required: true' in any AD JSON that needs reference photo input.

quality_standards.thumbnail_readability: Headline must be legible at 200x250px thumbnail size
quality_standards.scroll_stop_element: Every ad must have ONE primary scroll-stop element in zone 2 — a giant numeral, a face, or a high-contrast visual juxtaposition
quality_standards.z_pattern_hierarchy: Eyes move top-left (logo) → top-right or center (headline) → mid (subhead) → lower-left (trust) → bottom-right (CTA). Layout must reward this scan path.
